track.name: Physics & maths Python
track.item_order_rule: Each phase has four lessons in order and no checkpoint yet (restructured from the V1 general lessons).

items.title: Lab screen

questions.label: Fill

questions.explanation_after_check: Words go inside quote marks. Then print shows them on the lab screen.
questions.hint_before_check: print() shows whatever is inside the brackets.

questions.label: Predict
questions.ask: What does the lab screen show?
questions.explanation_after_check: print shows the words between the quote marks. The quote marks themselves are not shown.

questions.label: Fill

questions.explanation_after_check: Start with print, then brackets, and put the words inside quote marks.

items.title: Counting readings
items.intro: Say hello: Show messages and store numbers.

notebook.label: Build a line that shows 6 times…

questions.label: Predict
questions.ask: What shows?
questions.explanation_after_check: Without quote marks, Python does the maths: 7 + 5 = 12.
questions.hint_before_check: Without quote marks, Python does the maths.

questions.label: Predict
questions.ask: True or false: this shows 7 + 5.
questions.explanation_after_check: Quote marks make it a message. The words show, and no adding happens.

questions.label: Predict
questions.ask: There are 7 readings, then 5 more come. Which line shows 12?
questions.explanation_after_check: Leave off the quote marks so Python adds: 7 + 5 = 12.

questions.label: Predict
questions.ask: What shows?

questions.label: Fill
questions.ask: Build a line that shows 6 times 7
questions.explanation_after_check: Python uses * for times. 6 * 7 = 42.

items.title: Labelled meters
items.intro: Say hello: Show messages and store numbers.

notebook.label: Put 30 metres per second in the…
True or false: this shows mass.
Which line does this: show what…

questions.label: Fill
questions.ask: Put 30 metres per second in the box labelled speed
questions.explanation_after_check: One = puts a value into the box. Two == would ask a question instead.
questions.hint_before_check: A variable is a labelled box that holds a value.

questions.label: Predict
questions.ask: What shows?
questions.explanation_after_check: speed holds 30, so print(speed) shows 30.

questions.label: Predict
questions.ask: What shows?
questions.explanation_after_check: The newest value replaces the old one. The box now holds 45.

questions.label: Predict
questions.ask: True or false: this shows mass.
questions.explanation_after_check: Quote marks make mass a word, so the word shows and not what the box holds.

questions.label: Predict
questions.ask: Which line does this: show what the box holds?
questions.explanation_after_check: = stores a value. print(name) shows the value. Quote marks show the name itself.

items.title: Speeding up
items.intro: Say hello: Show messages and store numbers.

notebook.label: Tap the line with the mistake.
Which line does this: take away…

questions.label: Predict
questions.ask: The rocket gains 10 m/s. Which line updates speed?
questions.explanation_after_check: Take the old value, add 10, and put it back in the same box.
questions.hint_before_check: Take the old value, change it, and put it back in the same box.

questions.label: Predict
questions.ask: What shows?

questions.label: Fill
questions.ask: Friction takes away 15 m/s. Build the line.
questions.explanation_after_check: Take the old value, subtract 15, and put it back in the box.

questions.label: Fix
questions.ask: Tap the line with the mistake.
questions.explanation_after_check: The + needs a number after it. Fix: distance = distance + 4

b.feedback: That leaves the mistake in place.

questions.label: Predict
questions.ask: Which line does this: take away 1?
questions.explanation_after_check: + adds, - takes away, and * multiplies. The new value goes back in the box.

phases.title: Loops: repeat a step
phases.coding_idea: Repeat a step second after second

items.title: Ticks pass
items.intro: Loops: repeat a step: Repeat a step second after second.

notebook.label: How many times does Tick show?
The timer must tick 4 times. Fi…
Build the first line of a loop…
True or false: this shows Beep,…

questions.label: Predict
questions.ask: How many times does Tick show?
questions.explanation_after_check: The indented line runs once each time round. range(5) means 5 times.
questions.hint_before_check: The indented line repeats each time round.

questions.label: Fill
questions.ask: The timer must tick 4 times. Fill the blank.
questions.explanation_after_check: range(4) repeats 4 times.

questions.label: Predict
questions.ask: What shows, in order?
questions.explanation_after_check: Only the indented line repeats. The last line runs once, after the loop.

questions.label: Fill
questions.ask: Build the first line of a loop that runs 6 times
questions.explanation_after_check: A loop starts with for, a name, in, range(6) and a colon.

questions.label: Predict
questions.ask: True or false: this shows Beep, Done, Beep, Done, Beep, Done.
questions.explanation_after_check: Only the indented line repeats. Beep shows 3 times, then Done shows once.

items.title: Watch it move
items.intro: Loops: repeat a step: Repeat a step second after second.

notebook.label: A ball rolls 5 m every second,…
Each step doubles the number. W…
The ball should roll 4 m every…

questions.label: Predict
questions.ask: A ball rolls 5 m every second, starting at 10 m. How far is it at the end?
questions.explanation_after_check: Each round adds 5: 10 → 15 → 20 → 25.
questions.hint_before_check: Follow the loop one round at a time.

questions.label: Predict
questions.ask: A battery loses 10 units every second, starting with 50. How much is left?
questions.explanation_after_check: Each round takes away 10: 50 → 40 → 30 → 20.

questions.label: Predict
questions.ask: Each step doubles the number. What shows at the end?
questions.explanation_after_check: Each round doubles it: 2 → 4 → 8 → 16.

questions.label: Fill
questions.ask: The ball should roll 4 m every second. Fill the blank.
questions.explanation_after_check: Each round adds the blank. To go up by 4, the blank must be 4.

questions.label: Predict
questions.ask: True or false: this shows 3.
questions.explanation_after_check: total goes up by 1 each round, and the loop runs 3 times, so it ends at 3.

items.title: Counting seconds
items.intro: Loops: repeat a step: Repeat a step second after second.

questions.label: Predict
questions.ask: What numbers show?
questions.explanation_after_check: range(3) starts at 0 and stops before 3: 0, 1, 2.

questions.label: Predict
questions.ask: Which line does this: 2, 3, 4?
questions.explanation_after_check: range(n) starts at 0. range(a, b) starts at a and stops just before b.

questions.label: Predict
questions.ask: What numbers show?
questions.explanation_after_check: range(1, 4) starts at 1 and stops before 4.

questions.label: Predict
questions.ask: What shows?

questions.label: Fill
questions.ask: Show seconds 1 to 6. Build the first line of the loop.
questions.explanation_after_check: range(1, 7) starts at 1 and stops before 7, so it counts 1 to 6.

notebook.label: The experiment must run for 6 s…
How many lines show in total?

questions.label: Predict

questions.explanation_after_check: Both indented lines repeat together, in order, every round.

questions.label: Predict
questions.ask: The experiment must run for 6 seconds. Which loop fits?
questions.explanation_after_check: range(6) repeats 6 times.

questions.label: Predict
questions.ask: What shows?
questions.explanation_after_check: Each round adds 10: 40 → 50 → 60 → 70 → 80.

questions.label: Fix
questions.ask: This should show Tick 3 times. Tap the line with the mistake.
questions.explanation_after_check: The first line of a loop must end with a colon. Fix: for second in range(3):
questions.hint_before_check: The first line of a loop ends with a colon.

a.feedback: That leaves the mistake in place.

questions.label: Predict
questions.ask: How many lines show in total?
questions.explanation_after_check: 3 rounds with 2 lines each is 6 lines.

items.title: Sensor check
items.intro: Decisions: if / else: Light on or light off.

notebook.label: A cup of tea cools 1 degree a m…
Tap the line with the mistake.

questions.label: Predict
questions.ask: What shows?
questions.explanation_after_check: It goes up only while it is below 4: 0 → 1 → 2 → 3 → 4 → 4 → 4.

questions.label: Predict
questions.ask: What shows, in order?
questions.explanation_after_check: The loop counts 1, 2, 3. Only 2 matches, so Bounce shows once.

questions.label: Predict
questions.ask: A cup of tea cools 1 degree a minute until it reaches 100. What shows?
questions.explanation_after_check: It drops by 1 while it is above 100, then stops: 102 → 101 → 100.

questions.label: Fix
questions.ask: Tap the line with the mistake.
questions.explanation_after_check: One = stores a value. To ask a question, use ==. Fix: if light == "on":
questions.hint_before_check: Asking a question needs two equals signs.

b.feedback: That leaves the mistake in place.

questions.label: Predict
questions.ask: What shows?
questions.explanation_after_check: The loop counts 0 to 5. Only 3, 4, 5 are more than 2, so count is 3.
